title: AAPS 3.2.0.4 and NSCLIENTv3 has 10 Entries in queue
body:
A few days ago I noticed that I constantly have entries in the queue from the NSCLIENTV3 tab. The day before yesterday there were 9 and since yesterday there have been 10. I have already tried a complete synchronization but then when processing it it counts down from around 50,000 down to 10 and what remains. Otherwise everything looks good, I didn't find any errors, my data is apparently all being uploaded to Nightscout.

AAPS 3.2.0.4
NSCLIENTV3
NS-Host: 10be.de
NS-Version: 15.0.2

Last Logfile see attachmend

![Screenshot_20240909_125454_AAPS](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/71c146b7-ce39-4304-8fab-f66194ab1e51)

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16941921/AndroidAPS.log)

comments.body: reset logging to defaults, perform sync and upload logs again

the reason is not visible. probably not a worth to dig into it
thanks anyway

Actually, I have the same problem. I think something went wrong when we deleted an entry from the food database (maybe in NS and at the same time in AAPS).
